name: angular-focus-brackets
intent: Four angular comic brackets snap onto a TARGET card; lock engages accent brackets, meta LOCK ENGAGED, and accent slash.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Brackets, slash, and LOCK ENGAGED meta appear immediately with accent colour

acceptance: Idle: brackets retracted off-card; meta reads Awaiting focus lock; polite aria-live on status
Focus: brackets snap in over 660ms with primary colour
Lock: brackets turn accent; meta becomes LOCK ENGAGED; accent slash scales in; status announces locked
Second Focus click resets to idle
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows locked composition immediately
No network; effect stays inside stage
